purpose: Pinned official-source feature review for three additions to the architecture comparison. These additions establish no runtime result, benchmark score, isolation pass, performance claim or end-to-end coding result in this project workload.
method: Resolved each official repository's main commit with GitHub GET commits/main, then read README.md at that exact SHA through the connected GitHub reader. Search results were discovery only; claims below are based on pinned README bytes.

projects.supported_summary: Retain uses an LLM to extract facts, entities, relationships and temporal information. Recall combines semantic, keyword/BM25, graph and temporal retrieval with fusion, reranking and a token limit. Memories use bank IDs; the coding-agent integration describes a bank per repository and shared access across clients. A bank-specific MCP endpoint is documented. Self-hosted deployments can configure local model providers. The README also describes observations with supporting quotes and proof counts, and searchable pages organized in folders and projectable to Markdown. These are documented evidence/navigation capabilities, not independently verified original-conversation coordinate fidelity.
projects.suggested_comparison_boundary: Feature documentation only. Bank selectors and repository defaults have not been tested as cross-project authorization or isolation here. Do not import Hindsight's self-reported LongMemEval/accuracy claims into this project's measured results.

projects.supported_summary: Markdown files are authoritative and Milvus is a rebuildable index. The documented retrieval combines dense vectors, BM25 and reciprocal-rank fusion, followed by progressive search, section expansion and original-transcript reading. The API demonstrates source_prefix scope; collections are configurable. Local ONNX and Ollama embeddings are supported, while the documented Python API defaults to OpenAI. Optional background project/user-note maintenance is disabled by default.
projects.suggested_comparison_boundary: Feature documentation only. Source prefixes and collection selection have not been evaluated as an exact-project or authenticated isolation boundary. Original transcript access and progressive retrieval are documented capabilities; do not say these are absent.

evidence_sections: Features / Run locally and share across devices
projects.supported_summary: The service exposes persistent memory through MCP and HTTP, with SQLite/local ONNX and optional alternative backends. It documents semantic plus BM25 search, tag/time/store filters, consolidation and heuristic supersession of conflicting memories. The sqlite extra supplies local ONNX; without it the README warns of hash-embedding fallback. Optional summaries require a configured LLM. Bootstrap profiles are explicitly documented as not isolated by project.
projects.suggested_comparison_boundary: Feature documentation only. Tags/agent headers and store partitions are not independently measured authorization guarantees. Do not generalize the bootstrap-profile limitation to every scoped search path. Exclude the README's 5ms marketing statement from any measured comparison.
